class.name: EditorDerivedData
class.description: [EditorDerivedData] allocates on-disk locations for machine-generated artifacts (lightmaps, GI data, procedural bakes) keyed by the owning node's persistent identity: the containing scene's resource UID plus the node's unique-scene-ID chain (see [method Node.get_unique_scene_id_path]) plus a producer slot name. Producers ask for a path instead of choosing one, so renaming or moving a scene or node keeps resolving to the same bundle, while duplicating a node or scene allocates a fresh one on its next bake. Each producer registers its slot with [method register_slot]. Retained artifacts are stored under [code]res://__derived/[/code] and regenerated artifacts under [code]res://.godot/derived/[/code] by default, so built-in bakes require no project configuration. The legacy [code]editor/derived_data/slot_registry[/code] project setting is still read for backward compatibility. Each allocated bundle directory carries a [code]manifest.cfg[/code] recording its identity; read it through [method describe], never directly. A node must have been saved at least once before allocation so its unique IDs are settled — allocation fails with an error for unsaved (new or freshly duplicated) nodes. [b]Note:[/b] This class shouldn't be instantiated directly. Instead, access the singleton directly by its name.

method.name: bundle_for
method.description: Returns the bundle directory for [param owner]'s [param slot], allocating and creating it (manifest included) if the owner's identity has no bundle yet. Multi-file producers write their files inside this directory. Returns an empty string on failure (unknown slot, unsaved owner, or an identity mismatch against an existing manifest).

method.name: describe
method.description: Returns the manifest contents (slot, schema, producer, scene UID, ID chain, human-readable labels, timestamps, plus [code]bundle_dir[/code]) for any path under a derived data root, or an empty dictionary if the path belongs to no bundle. This is the only supported way to read a bundle manifest.

method.name: file_for
method.description: Single-file convenience over [method bundle_for]: returns [code]data.[param ext][/code] inside the owner's bundle for [param slot], allocating the bundle if needed. [param ext] is a bare extension without a dot. Returns an empty string on failure.

method.name: has_slot
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a producer or optional project extension has registered [param slot].

method.name: owns
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the bundle containing [param artifact_path] is owned by [param owner] for [param slot]: its manifest identity matches the node's current key. A [code]false[/code] result on a referenced artifact means the node is living off another node's bake (for example after a paste) and its next bake will fork into a fresh bundle that the caller must repoint to.

method.name: register_slot
method.description: Registers a derived-data slot owned by a producer. Editor plugins should call this during initialization instead of requiring users to configure a central slot table. Re-registering the same slot from the same producer is allowed.
